prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: portrait backdrop for Split, an illustrated beer-sipping game. New Halloween scene: Midnight carnival.
Scene/backdrop: a vintage seaside boardwalk carnival on Halloween night. Crooked striped sideshow booths, a distant old Ferris wheel with small amber bulbs, paper skull garlands and carved jack-o-lantern lanterns. Friendly distant adult friends dressed in Halloween costumes stand at the right edge talking by a booth. The center lane is empty, violet night sky and faint mist beyond.
Style/medium: refined painterly travel illustration with soft brushwork, believable worn materials and perspective, nostalgic postcard quality.
Composition/framing: 1024 by 1536 portrait, seated viewpoint from a carnival beer table. An EMPTY weathered wooden tabletop spans the entire lower 40%; rear table edge near 60% frame height. Keep central x=.32 through .68 calm and open for a large separately rendered pint. Halloween props and booths sit around left and right edges and above the tabletop, with no foreground objects in the middle.
Lighting/mood: inky ultramarine sky, dusty plum shadows, pools of amber bulbs and orange pumpkin light; unmistakably Halloween, enchanting and social, no horror gore.
Constraints: background only, no foreground drink or glass, beer bottle, labels, lettering, logos, words, UI, frame or watermark. Painted illustration, opaque full bleed. Empty central tabletop essential.
